title: NickHub Smart Esp and Adjustable Aimbot Anti Ban
features:
🟢 NICKHUB New Gen - DEFUSE DIVISION 🟢

The wait is over. The most optimized script with Smart Team Detection is here. No more broken ESP or jittery aimbot.

• Automatically scans nearby players at spawn for 15s to identify teammates.

🖥️ Sharp Native UI Clean, centered text aesthetic, optimized performance, and crash-free toggle system.

Execute the script.
